implementation_license: MIT for the independently implemented reader grammar; retained permissive license with no-endorsement clause for the private Blowfish implementation
implementation: Static bounded SVFS package parsing and native stored/zlib/Blowfish-CBC decoding. Packaged executables and installers are never executed. GPL upstream writer/runtime source is used as grammar reference and retained separately as noncompiled test reference, not linked into the runtime reader.

primary_sources.purpose: Original writer, catalog and runtime grammar; 32-bit serialized pointers, 52-byte nodes, encrypted 48-byte header, tree CRC32, 48-KiB block CRC16, MD5 mount keys and 15-byte Blowfish key schedule.

primary_sources.license: Permissive MIT-style grant plus copyright-holder no-endorsement clause; full original notice retained in molebox_blowfish.inc
primary_sources.adaptations: Private names and context, runtime memcpy, const constants, explicit little-endian loads/stores instead of unaligned native word casts. Cipher rounds and key schedule retained.

supported: Win32 SVFS/SPACK STELPACK package header and original writer tree layout
Standalone packages and packages referenced by an EOF MoleBox internal mount catalog
Stored and zlib-compressed 48-KiB blocks, with optional zero-IV Blowfish CBC and CRC16 verification
Public UTF-16LE filenames, directories, empty files and hidden-file payloads exported under stored MD5 path signatures
Default password, supplied plaintext password, supplied molebox-md5:<32hex> credential and actual recoverable embedded mount key
Current-password metadata uses a reusable embedded key credential; original plaintext is not recoverable from MD5
Cursor-preserving candidate probe and full password-aware detector; no temporary files in TEST
limitations: Legacy MoleBox 2.x and other layouts without this verified SVFS/SPACK grammar are unsupported.
Original hidden names are absent from the format and cannot be reconstructed from path hashes; hidden payloads use stable hash names.
Standalone custom-password packages require a supplied password/key; header encryption prevents ordinary automatic detection without it.
Only internal packages present in the input are read. External mount packages and runtime mount-mask behavior are not recreated.
Original PE image reconstruction, virtual registry state and additional stream/registry blobs are not implemented.
Packages must end with the verified standalone header or mount catalog; unrelated data appended afterward is not scanned heuristically.

independent_proof.producer: Original upstream packager.cpp serialization and pebox.cpp catalog writer body compiled as Win32 with test RAM adapters, original xternal Blowfish and standard zlib compressed vectors
independent_proof.runtime_test_dependencies: Python standard library and the native probe only
independent_proof.native_result: 149 checks / 35 fixtures; 12 original-writer valid vectors including two differently keyed packages
